checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is visible, and there are multiple side windows along the passenger compartment.

The size and window configuration suggest a capacity consistent with a minibus (4-10 passengers).

The vertical lines of the building in the background show slight warping and inconsistency with the perspective of the vehicle, though this is minor.
The person's hand/arm area where it interacts with the open door lacks clear separation. The fingers seem to merge with the door edge or interior, lacking distinct anatomical definition.
